directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 30 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. Main-unit weight is is 1200 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_of_measurement.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动30型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm。理论输送量是12–15 m³/h，最大出口压力是20 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_of_measurement。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_of_measurement. The image subject is Weights and Measures office. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 30 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. The frame “Mobile crane” shows Truck mounted crane building a bridge and is not a site measurement of this model. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_of_measurement。画面内容是Weights and Measures office。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动30型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 1200 kg. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. Subject: Truck mounted crane building a bridge. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³.
body.zh: 理论输送量是12–15 m³/h，最大出口压力是20 MPa。主体：Truck mounted 起重机 building a bridge。

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Main-unit weight is is 1200 kg. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Output Capacity. Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 60 m / 180 m.
body.zh: 画面「Mobile crane」的主体是Truck mounted 起重机 building a bridge，不是这个型号的工地实测。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Output Capacity is 12–15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. The shown output stays 12–15 m³/h. Main-unit weight is 1200 kg.
body.zh: 外形尺寸是3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm。细石输送（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_of_measurement.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_of_measurement画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 12–15 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_of_measurement.
